title: guardscope: Measuring Which Actions Runtime Controls Check in LLM Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.15223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-language model (LLM) agents execute actions on external systems through tool calls, and enterprises deploy runtime controls, such as agent gateways, to check this behavior in real time. However, a control can only evaluate the actions that cross the point where it is placed, and an agent can act through more paths than the tool-call channel; no existing work measures this coverage against kernel-level ground truth. In this paper, we present guardscope, a framework that makes this coverage measurable. guardscope works in two stages: a static stage that predicts which of an agent's 15 action paths a control can check from its source, and an empirical stage that runs a fixed workload on a deployment that realizes one of eight topology designs and classifies every executed action as checked, bypassed, or prevented by reconciling the control's decision records against kernel-level ground truth. guardscope makes a control's coverage clai

translated_title: guardscope：测量LLM智能体系统中运行时控制检查了哪些操作
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.15223v1 公告类型：新论文。大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过工具调用在外部系统上执行操作，企业部署运行时控制（如智能体网关）来实时检查这种行为。然而，控制只能评估经过其部署位置的操作，而智能体可以通过比工具调用通道更多的路径执行操作；目前尚无现有工作针对内核级别的真实情况来测量这种覆盖率。本文提出guardscope，一个使这种覆盖率可测量的框架。guardscope分两个阶段工作：静态阶段根据控制的源代码预测其可以检查智能体15条操作路径中的哪几条；实证阶段在实现了八种拓扑设计之一的部署上运行固定工作负载，并通过将控制的决策记录与内核级别的真实情况进行比对，将每个已执行的操作分类为已检查、被绕过或被阻止。guardscope使控制的覆盖率声明……
tldr: guardscope是一个通过静态分析预测可检查的操作路径、并结合内核级实证验证将操作分类为已检查、被绕过或被阻止的框架，首次实现了对LLM智能体系统中运行时控制覆盖率的量化测量。
en_tdlr: guardscope is a two-stage framework—static path prediction plus kernel-level empirical verification—that for the first time makes the coverage of runtime controls in LLM agent systems measurable by classifying executed actions as checked, bypassed, or prevented.
